subject: Adventurer Karl Bushby ends a 28-year walk from Chile in Hull wearing the club shirt
title: Twenty-eight years, no lifts

lines.vo: Twenty-eight years of walking, and absolutely no lifts.
lines.footage: Bushby arrival in Hull, walking shots, gear close-up

lines.vo: Karl Bushby set off from Chile in nineteen ninety-eight. Destination: Hull. Some people love a long commute.
About thirty-one thousand miles, across four continents.
The rules: no buses, no trains, no lifts. And no coming home until he finished.
He swam the Channel on the fifth of October to start the final leg. A ferry would have been cheating.
lines.footage: Channel swim b-roll, sea and white cliffs

lines.vo: Hull City urged fans to welcome him at City Hall. After the two-two with Ipswich, the club posted his video in a Hull shirt.
lines.footage: club video clip, City Hall square

lines.vo: Twenty-eight years on foot. He hopes to watch a match at the MKM Stadium. Sitting down.
lines.footage: MKM Stadium exterior, stands in the sunshine
